title: Northwind Logistics webhook outage: customer update

thread.text: Escalation from Northwind Logistics. Webhook delivery was down for them for about 3 hours on Sept 11 (14:05 to 17:10 UTC). Tracking in INC-4471. Their shipment status events never reached their dispatch system.

Root cause on INC-4471 was an expired TLS cert on the webhook egress proxy in us-east-2. Cert rotated 17:10 UTC, backlog of 18,240 events replayed by 18:30 UTC. Postmortem draft is in the incident doc.
Dana Okafor (VP Ops, dana.okafor@northwind.example) wants a written update before their exec review. It needs to go out by 17:00 PT today.
Heads up: do not promise a credit or refund in the update. Any SLA credit goes through the contract review next week, not through CS.
